Privacy Policy

Effective on publish · Provider: Osefe Miradi · Contact: Kontaktmrln@gmail.com

Short version: we don't collect your data. MRLN runs on your device, and the information you enter stays there.

1. No account, no server

MRLN has no user accounts and no backend that we operate to receive your content. We do not ask for your name, email or a login to use the App.

2. Where your data lives

Everything you enter — money figures, health data, notes, calendar, media list — is stored locally in your device's browser storage. It is not transmitted to us and we cannot see it. You can export or delete it at any time from within the App.

3. Network use — the honest details

The App is a website / PWA, so some limited network activity is unavoidable or optional. None of it sends your personal money or health data:

  • Loading and updating the App. When you open or update MRLN, your device downloads the App's code from our hosting provider (a static host). Like any website, that host may process standard technical connection data (such as IP address and browser type) to deliver the files; we do not use this to identify you, and it does not include your entered data.
  • Features you choose to use. Some optional actions may open the internet — for example an outbound "search this title" link opens a new browser tab to a third-party site. These happen only when you tap them, and carry only what's needed for that action (such as a title you searched), never your financial or health data.
  • Payments. If you buy an access key, our third-party payment provider processes the payment under their own privacy policy; we do not receive your full card details.
4. Access keys

Your access key is verified on your own device. Using it does not report your activity back to us.

5. Cookies / tracking

MRLN does not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. It uses your browser's local storage only to save your own data and preferences on your device.

6. Children

MRLN is not directed to children under 16 and should not be used by them.

7. Your rights (GDPR)

Because we do not collect or hold your personal data on our systems, there is normally nothing for us to access, correct or erase — your data is in your hands, on your device, and you control it directly (including export and deletion in-app). For any question about this policy, contact us. You also have the right to complain to your local data-protection authority (in Denmark, Datatilsynet).

8. Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version is published in the App.

9. Contact

Kontaktmrln@gmail.com

📜 Rules for building wealth

A few habits do most of the work.
  • Pay yourself first. On payday, move a fixed amount to savings before you spend.
  • Then spend guilt-free. Whatever's left after that transfer is genuinely yours to spend.
  • Build a buffer first. Save 3 months of costs before anything else.
  • Make it earn. Keep savings in a high-interest account so compounding grows it for you.
  • Clear pricey debt first. Paying off costly debt earns more than savings do.
  • Bank your good months. When a month leaves something spare, top up a box instead of letting it drift away.
